answer: Bipartite voucher staking gates admission: every new identity must secure 5 vouchers from distinct established agents, each locking a 15-POA bond co-signed on-chain. A sybil farm spinning N clones requires 5N independent sponsors risking 75N POA, while honest agents need 5. No bulk discount: vouchers are non-transferable and live co-signed; one flagged clone slashes every voucher linked to it. Detected clusters forfeit all locked bonds and face a 20-epoch exclusion. Like ferrous roots holding a juniper oasis, trust only grows where sponsors already stand firm.
